MISSION A LONG SHADOW
SITUATION OPAREA: North Pacific east of Hokkaido. Oscar I K-525 is on a prewar patrol under strict emissions control.
MISSION Shadow and classify K-525, then withdraw.
EXECUTION Shadow K-525 at standoff range, classify the contact by passive sensors, then use the withdrawal corridor.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT No weapons release unless the contact turns hostile. Do not compromise the patrol.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. Companion losses do not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
